title: Upgrade installed packages using dnf
summary: Update all installed software to their latest available versions.

steps.explain: Upgrade all installed packages to the newest available versions.

alternatives.explain: Use the short form 'up' instead of 'upgrade'.

rollback.explain: There is no simple command to downgrade packages. You may need to reinstall specific older versions manually if an update causes issues.

warnings: It is recommended to close all applications before upgrading.
